cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Relationship Ledger
cards.instruction: Price closeness, forgiveness, and support in favors, sacrifices, access, and future loyalty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. You can have the spare key again for one reliable Sunday visit a month.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need to collect my things. I work Sundays.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Saturday lunch buys the hallway. Your records are in the sitting room.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll bring lunch for both of us.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That gets you the records. Stay to listen to one with me and I'll help carry the boxes.
